prompt:
Create one landscape 3:2 architectural MOOD BOARD on a plain warm light background for a vanilla Minecraft 1.21.1 build of THE MAIN ARCADE AND NORTH ARCADE, PIKE PLACE MARKET, SEATTLE (1907). Crisp voxel rendering, visible individual Minecraft blocks, no characters or animals, no dropped fish entities. Exterior only, warm dusk lighting in stalls and windows. Title: "PIKE PLACE / MAIN ARCADE" and subtitle "1907 • 1.4 blocks / metre • Minecraft 1.21.1".

Layout: upper half has THREE separated small whole-building thumbnail takes, each showing the complete very long tapering building including its narrow North Arcade tail. First is the hero southeast street-corner view, second a west downhill view exposing Down Under storeys, third a higher isometric roof/massing study. Explore modest differences of shed roof stepping, awning rhythm and stall arrangement, but each unmistakably the same real market building with its iconic sign at the SOUTH END. Use the long narrow actual site proportions: plot 43 blocks east-west by 312 blocks north-south, wide southern main building tapering into an extremely narrow northern covered arcade. Main roof approximately y49 above lowest ground. North at low z, south at high z; east is high x uphill Pike Place street, west is low x downhill Elliott Bay. Do not rotate the building between concepts; cameras can change. Add small orientation arrows labeled "+z SOUTH / Pike Street", "+x EAST / Pike Place", "-x WEST / Bay". A small diagram may communicate the taper: only column 4 of seven at the north for 19 rows, then columns 4–5, broadening gradually westward to columns 0–5 at the south, final row columns 1–5; seven blocks per map cell. All construction remains on that tapering footprint. Ground rises west to east, approximately y2–13 downhill to y18–23 at street level. Show stepped foundations meeting the slope, extra lower west-facing floors, no floating structure or buried facades.

Architecture: continuous open east street arcade under low dark shed roofs, slender green-painted posts, white-painted brick and wood upper walls, two to three upper storeys with repeated multi-pane windows. The downhill west side has tiers of windows and substantial exposed lower Down Under levels. North tail is a long open covered craft market on posts over tables. SOUTH high-z corner is the focal point: white rooftop steel-like block frame carrying large red illuminated block letters "PUBLIC MARKET CENTER", facing diagonally toward +x and +z up Pike Street. Directly below, stepped pixel-round clock with white face, dark hands and red illuminated ring; wording "PUBLIC MARKET". Under clock a wooden sign "MEET THE PRODUCER", then open corner fish-market entrance with packed-ice display counters. Produce and flower stalls use pumpkins, melons, decorative red blocks as apples, wooden crates, flower pots, colorful flowers, hanging lanterns, restrained cream/green/red canvas-like wool awnings. Red neon simulated only by red stained glass over glowstone and red concrete block letters. All architectural forms are buildable block geometry.

Middle strip: clearly organized block swatches by role, individual actual Minecraft cubes, each with its EXACT namespaced block id legibly lettered beneath, monospaced small type. WALLS: minecraft:white_concrete and minecraft:calcite. TRIM / POSTS: minecraft:dark_oak_planks and minecraft:green_terracotta. ROOF: minecraft:deepslate_tile_stairs and minecraft:deepslate_tile_slab. WINDOWS: minecraft:glass_pane. ACCENTS / NEON: minecraft:red_concrete, minecraft:red_stained_glass, minecraft:glowstone. STALL LIGHT: minecraft:lantern. Label all eleven swatches precisely, arranged in two clean rows if needed.

Bottom: FOUR detailed close-up callouts, with fine leader lines and concise labels: 01 rooftop PUBLIC MARKET CENTER red block neon, white support frame and stepped circular clock; 02 green post and low shed eave with lantern, striped wool awning and colorful produce/flower stall; 03 white upper facade with repeated multi-pane window and warmly lit shallow shop display; 04 south corner entrance, "MEET THE PRODUCER" sign and fish-counter packed ice. Maintain crisp voxel geometry even in enlarged details. Refined catalog layout with generous margins and readable text. Only vanilla blocks that exist in Java Minecraft 1.21.1; no pale oak, no later blocks, no smooth real-world geometry, no custom textures, no mod assets. Make the red sign and clock the visual hero.
reads: Huge red illuminated PUBLIC MARKET CENTER letters on a white rooftop frame.
White pixel-round clock with dark hands and a glowing red rim beside the sign.
MEET THE PRODUCER sign above the open south-corner entrance.
Long street arcade with green posts, low dark eaves and striped awnings.
Colorful produce and flower counters, wooden crates and hanging lanterns.
White upper facades with repeated tall multi-pane windows glowing warmly at dusk.
Extra downhill Down Under storeys with tiers of west-facing windows.
Long, narrow North Arcade extending from the broader southern building.
Fish-market entrance with ice display counters beneath the corner signage.
